tcv._readme: Identity merges for TCV (PRO-169). The filing layers name a company by its registered or former name while the firm's compliance list and grid use the brand (Maplebear / Instacart, Themis Solutions / Clio, Grow Care / Grow Therapy), and EDGAR keeps a registrant's old name after a rename (XATA / XRS, INVESTools / thinkorswim Group). Canonical is the live site row. Archived renderings are mapped in the parsed layer itself by scratch/canon-archive.py (name_listed keeps the archive's text), so they need no merge here. Written 2026-09-29 after the first build and before any judged verdict.

merges.reason: XATA Corp. renamed itself XRS Corporation in 2012; the compliance list carries XRS, EDGAR the old registered name (same CIK).
Dough, Inc. is Tastytrade's former name (the compliance list: "Tastytrade, Inc. (fka Dough, Inc.)"); the Form D names John Rosenberg.
Grow Care, Inc. is Grow Therapy's registered name (the compliance list); the Form D names Gautam Gupta.
Internet Pipeline, Inc. is iPipeline's registered name (the compliance list; the firm's 2016 post "ipipeline-announces-investment-by-technology-crossover-ventures"); the Form D names Robert Trudeau.
Just Fabulous, Inc. is TechStyle's former name (the compliance list: "TechStyle, Inc. (fka Just Fabulous, Inc.)"); the Form D names John Drew.
Maplebear Inc. is Instacart's registered name (the compliance list: "Maplebear Inc. (dba Instacart)").
Themis Solutions Inc. is Clio's registered name (the compliance list: "Themis Solutions Inc. (dba Clio)"); the Form D names Amol Helekar.
INVESTools Inc. acquired thinkorswim in 2007 and renamed itself thinkorswim Group Inc. in 2009 (same registrant); the compliance list carries Thinkorswim Group, EDGAR the old name.
